musical preferences are a valid indicator of individual differences in personality, as demonstrated by the ability of musical preferences to predict personality above and beyond demographic characteristics (e.g., age, gender), and that the personality traits associated with musical preferences are differentially associated with different music preference dimensions.

musical preferences, as measured by behavioral reactions to unfamiliar musical stimuli and by Facebook Likes, predict individual differences in personality, above and beyond demographic characteristics.

active listening and Facebook Likes for musical genres and musical artists are associated with the Big Five personality traits of extraversion, agreeableness, conscientiousness, and openness, but not with neuroticism.
